name: popover
description: Floating panel anchored to a trigger with interactive content, closing on outside click and Escape
designIntent: Popover displays interactive content (links, buttons, forms) in a floating panel. Unlike Tooltip, the content is focusable and actionable. Closes on outside click and Escape.

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when the open state changes

examples.title: Simple popover
examples.description: Popover with text and a button

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Popover for plain text hints
antiPatterns.explanation: Use Tooltip for non-interactive hints. Popover is for interactive content.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Popover for critical forms or destructive actions
antiPatterns.explanation: Popovers close on outside click, which can interrupt form filling. Use Dialog for forms and destructive confirmations.

accessibility.implementation: role=dialog with aria-labelledby linking to the trigger
accessibility.userRequirements: Trigger must have a visible accessible name
Keep the trigger focusable after close

guidelines: Include at least one interactive element
